nodes.name: .mcp.json
nodes.summary: Empty MCP server registry for the Fastify server package, defining a placeholder mcpServers object with no registered servers.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Package manifest for the @waggle/server Fastify sidecar, declaring its ESM exports (main, local, routes), dev/start scripts, and a rich dependency set including Fastify 5, Clerk auth, BullMQ job queue, ioredis, Drizzle ORM, WebSocket support, and all internal @waggle/* workspace packages.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses ESM type:module with explicit exports map exposing src/*.ts directly (transpile-only via tsx at runtime; tsc is used for type-checking only per CLAUDE.md notes).

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the @waggle/server sidecar, targeting ES2022 with strict mode, composite project references to @waggle/shared, and declaration map output to dist/.
